decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-rated options across different price points, but encountered specific deal-breakers in the reviews for each. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is highly rated but reviews pointed out a lack of backward compatibility with older JBL speakers (Connect+), which is a requirement for my existing setup. The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) had concerning reviews regarding the quality of units received through non-primary buy options. Both the DOSS Traveler (prod_bluetooth_speakers_061) and BOGASING M4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_174) had reports of durability issues, specifically units failing to charge or dying within a few months. Finally, while the Edifier S350DB (prod_bluetooth_speakers_037) offers superior sound, its $399 price tag and lack of portability make it unsuitable for my current need for a versatile outdoor-capable speaker. Given these inconsistencies and compatibility issues, I have decided to postpone my purchase.
